[4:40PM] #LagosIbadanExpress #Ogudu #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic is quite slow from Olopomeji and descending the Gbagada bridge inwards Ifako bridge where the expansion joints will slow you down a bit, and better inwards Ogudu, Alapere, Apostolic and Ojota Bridge.

Moving in to Old Toll Gate, Conoil, Magodo/Alausa Bridge to Otedola an do Berger inwards Kara is quite slow due ti an incident at OPIC.

Our Men are strategically positioned within our Jurisdiction to ensure smooth traffic flow.
